whenToUse: Content that can be partly previewed, such as paid articles, courses, or reports.
Content visible after signing in or joining.
The price or terms fit in one line.
whenNotToUse: Someone else must grant access (use permission denied).
Content that can't be understood when locked without a preview.
You'd show the full content to search engines and hide it only from people.

alternatives.name: Permission Denied
alternatives.reason: Access must be requested from the owner.

accessibility: The locked part isn't real text blurred out; it isn't rendered at all, so it can't be read by screen readers or in the page source.
The fading gradient is decorative, so it's aria-hidden.
State the terms (price, eligibility) in text near the button first.
